steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Ice in Filter environments. Click Ice Caverns, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Make a cold side with the Ice Berg and the Thermometer 31F. Make a warm side with the Sun, the Thermometer 85F and the Glass Jar.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “On the cold side, water is a ___. On the warm side, it is a ___ because ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add a model of one tiny piece of water: H20 Molecule

studio.title: Turn the heat dial

labels.start: Change the temperature and watch the photo.
labels.tooHot: Too hot for this job. Cool it a little.
labels.done: Melting, boiling, condensation and freezing. Heat and cold changed the water every time. Nice work, crew!

studio.look: A temperature dial and a photo of water. Temperature is how hot or cold something is. Water freezes at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C. The photo shows what the water looks like at that temperature.
studio.do: Read the job. Drag the slider, or tap Warmer and Cooler. When the water changes, tap the name of the change.

frames.lead: 1. What does heat do to water?
2. What does cooling do to water?
frames.starter: When water gets colder, ___, like when ___.

studio.full: You turned the dial for all 4 jobs and named each change. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

voice.brief: Welcome to the ice cave, crew. We film Scene 27, The Puddle Case. Show me how heat changes water, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Ice, and pick Ice Caverns. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Build a cold side and a warm side. Put the ice berg where it stays frozen. Then tell me what water is on each side.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a model of one tiny piece of water. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Turn the heat dial and watch the water change. Then tell me what you think.
